title: The frontend puts an example hint under Number of animals — 'For example, 1, 25 or 5000.' — that DR1 does not have.

finding.frontend: Each Number of animals input carries the hint 'For example, 1, 25 or 5000.' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:27-30, rendered at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/consignment-details/_species-quantities.njk:11-20). On a consignment with several species the hint repeats under every line.
finding.prototype: DR1's Number of animals input has a label and nothing else — no hint element and no aria-describedby on the input, where the packages input on the same page does carry a hint (app/views/consignment-details.html:105-114). The two sides agree on the packages hint word for word, so the difference is confined to this one field.
finding.difference: Remove the animals hint from the commodities copy file and drop the hint argument from the input in the species-quantities template, in English and Welsh. Keep the packages hint, which matches DR1 exactly.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a hint rendered under Number of animals on DR1's Commodity details page.

relatedTo.why: Both are one-line edits to the same copy block for the two fields on a commodity line.
